messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm drafting the rotation + audit plan for KMS keys used by Redwood Private (VPC). Need sync on: (1) separation of control-plane vs data-plane KEKs, (2) rotation flow (automatic CMK rotate vs rewrap), (3) cache invalidation for DEKs, (4) CloudTrail/CloudWatch audit traces and retention. Who's available?

mira: available. For separation: recommend two customer-scoped CMKs per environment: alias/rw-controlplane-kek and alias/rw-dataplane-kek. Control-plane KEK only used by control-plane services (auth, config, metadata); dataplane KEK used for encrypting model artifacts and wrapping DEKs. Keeps blast radius small.

sam: quick note — data-plane nodes cache DEKs in Redis and local memory. On rotation we must rewrap the stored ciphertext and push a cache-invalidate event, otherwise nodes will continue using stale DEKs and hit Decrypt failures.

jordan: agreed. Proposed flow: create new CMK (or enable rotated CMK) -> batch ReEncrypt existing ciphertext blobs to new CMK (KMS:ReEncrypt) -> atomically swap DEK pointers in metadata store -> publish cache-invalidate event to nodes. ReEncrypt should be idempotent + resumable.

mira: RBAC considerations: least-privilege IAM role mappings. Example: control-plane role gets kms:GenerateDataKey,kms:Decrypt,kms:ReEncrypt on alias/rw-controlplane-kek only. Dataplane role gets equivalent scoped to dataplane KEK. Rotation lambda/service gets kms:ReEncrypt on both, plus kms:CreateGrant for short-lived cross-account access. Key policy must explicitly include the rotation principal and the management CI role.

alex: ops runbook snippet for manual rewrap (put in ops doc):

```
aws kms re-encrypt \ 
  --ciphertext-blob fileb://encrypted-dek.bin \ 
  --destination-key-id alias/rw-controlplane-kek \ 
  --source-encryption-context "env=prod,customer=acct-123"
```

sam: cache invalidation pattern: rotation job performs ReEncrypt + writes new_dek_id to metadata DB within transaction, then publishes to SNS topic `rw/key-rotation/invalidations`. Node agents subscribe and drop local/Redis cache when they see the event. Include a short backoff window for in-flight requests.

ops-bot: Created ticket ROT-8345 and attached initial checklist: precheck CloudTrail logging, snapshot metadata DB, dry-run on staging, run rewrap in 10k batch windows, verify decrypt on nodes, then mark complete. https://tickets.internal/ROT-8345

sec-bot: Reminder: CloudTrail records KMS events like GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, ReEncrypt. Make sure our SIEM ingests these and that we have an alert for ReEncrypt events initiated by unexpected principals. Suggest metric filter for eventName=ReEncrypt and create alarm if source IP/principal deviates. Also ensure CloudTrail retention meets compliance (90/365 days per policy).

jordan: rotation cadence thoughts: CMKs — rotate/replace yearly (or use AWS automatic yearly rotation where supported) but prefer explicit scheduled replacement to capture rollover plan. DEKs — rotate on shorter cadence (30–90 days) depending on sensitivity; for high-risk customers consider rolling DEKs daily. For a key compromise playbook: disable old CMK ASAP, run emergency rewrap to a pre-provisioned fallback key, send invalidate event, and revoke grants.

mira: cross-account Dedicated pools: prefer using grants (CreateGrant) scoped to the external principal and limited operations (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey). Use grant tokens when creating ephemeral instances so there's no race on using a newly created grant. For BYOK/HSM cases, ensure key policy includes the external account principals and KMS key origin constraints.

alex: audit/observability action items:
- CloudTrail -> SIEM ingestion + ReEncrypt/GenerateDataKey alerts
- CloudWatch metric filters for malformed decrypt/failures during rotation windows
- Add correlation IDs in rotation tooling so rewrap runs produce traceable logs (trace_id in metadata and CloudTrail event custom attributes where possible)

alex: Action owners: (A) Mira to draft IAM key policies + RBAC matrix by EOD Thu. (B) Sam to prototype SNS invalidation consumer + run staging dry-run rewrap. (C) Jordan to author CloudTrail->SIEM rule and metric filters. (D) Ops to flesh out ROT-8345 runbook with batch limits and rollback steps.

alex: Thanks all — ping me if you want pairing for the rewrap tool. :thumbsup:
